root_cause.text: The `ipu6_pci_probe()` function in the Intel IPU6 PCI driver fails to release the runtime PM reference on the auxiliary device (`isp->psys->auxdev.dev`) when jumping to the error cleanup path.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `goto out_ipu6_bus_del_devices;` with `goto out_ipu6_rpm_put;` in multiple error paths within `ipu6_pci_probe()`, introducing a call to `pm_runtime_put_sync(&isp->psys->auxdev.dev)` to prevent the reference leak.
